thread:
auditor_sam: Hi team — auditor here. Need a concise deliverable: timeline + artifacts for the KMS key rotation that happened during INC-2026-0312, and the RBAC change approvals that accompanied it. Auditor wants mapping to SOC 2 control CC6.1 and ISO A.10.1. Please list one canonical artifact per item.

olivia_sec: Hi Sam — we can do that. Quick Q: do you want presigned artifacts or copies uploaded to the auditor bucket?

auditor_sam: presigned links are fine if they expire after the fieldwork window. Prefer hashes + short explanation for provenance.

mike_infra: short plan:
- KMS rotation timeline (Cloud KMS logs + rotation job run)
- RBAC PR + approval thread (GitHub + audit log snapshot)
- Incident ticket and timeline (INC-2026-0312)
- Vulnerability triage note linking to the decision to rotate key
- Proof of inability to access decrypted secrets pre-rotation (test logs)

olivia_sec: I'm attaching the pointer links below. I'll redact internal hostnames.
- Rotation job run: https://logs.redwood.example.com/job/rotations/rot-2026-0312-01
- KMS event export: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-audit/audits/2026-03/kms-rotation-events.json?X-EX=presigned
- RBAC PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842 (approved by @diana_oncall)

mike_infra: also adding the Splunk query we used to pull the KMS events:
```
index=cloud_kms action=key_rotate key_id="projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/primary" | table _time, user, action, request_id
```

olivia_sec: sample KMS log snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-03-12T18:42:12Z user:mike_infra action:cryptoKeyVersion.create request_id:abcd-1234 rotation_job:rot-2026-0312-01
2026-03-12T18:42:15Z user:mike_infra action:cryptoKeyVersion.setPrimary request_id:abcd-1234
2026-03-12T18:42:16Z system action:keyVersion.destroy request_id:abcd-1234
```

diana_oncall: Confirming I approved PR #842 at 2026-03-12T18:30Z via GitHub web UI + 2FA. GitHub audit export attached: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-audit/audits/2026-03/github-approvals.csv?X-EX=presigned

auditor_sam: For RBAC you also need the policy diff and the service account justification.

olivia_sec: policy diff (PR includes diff) and separate justification doc: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-audit/docs/rbac-justifications/2026-03-12-rot.pdf?X-EX=presigned

mike_infra: Vulnerability triage ticket that triggered the rotation: RED-2026-1145. Short summary: a partial disclosure of a signer key in a staging log prompted rotation of the prod KMS key as precaution. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2026-1145 (view-only link given to auditor via access request).

olivia_sec: Triage note excerpt: "No evidence of exfil from prod. Rotated key to close window. RBAC change restricted access to 'kms-operators' until rotation validated."

auditor_sam: Can you provide proof that customer data decryption was unavailable to the rotated key during the transition? Need a test or replay.

mike_infra: We ran a smoke test after rotation showing decryption failing for the old key and succeeding for the new primary. Test logs: https://logs.redwood.example.com/tests/kms-rot-smoke-2026-03-12.log
Sample lines: 
```
2026-03-12T19:01:02Z test:decrypt key_version:old error:NotFound
2026-03-12T19:01:05Z test:decrypt key_version:new status:OK
```

diana_oncall: Also note we followed the change control runbook CHG-2025-12. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kms-rotation (auditor has read access).

auditor_sam: Good. Last ask: can you map each artifact to the control language? Example: KMS logs -> CC6.1 evidence of key lifecycle; GitHub approval CSV -> evidence of change approval. A short table in the thread would be perfect.

olivia_sec: Will do a 1-paragraph mapping for each artifact and upload a zipped manifest to the auditor bucket. ETA 24h.

ops-bot: Deploy finished: rotation-manifest-upload v1 -> s3://redwood-audit/audits/2026-03/rotation-manifest-v1.zip (presigned link sent to auditors). :white_check_mark:

auditor_sam: Thanks. Please add hashes (sha256) for each file and a short blurb describing how you generated the artifact (query, time window). That satisfies the provenance checklist.

mike_infra: Will include sha256 and the Splunk/S3 query used. tagging the ticket RED-2026-1145.

olivia_sec: Noted. I'll update when upload is done.

auditor_sam: Appreciated. If possible include IAM policy dump for the affected service account at the time of change (policy snapshot).

mike_infra: policy snapshot path: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-audit/policy-snapshots/2026-03-12/kms-operators.json?X-EX=presigned

olivia_sec: Upload complete — manifest v1 includes: rotation log export, github approval CSV, RBAC diff PDF, triage ticket export, smoke test log, policy snapshot, sha256sums.txt. Link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-audit/audits/2026-03/rotation-manifest-v1.zip?X-EX=presigned

auditor_sam: I confirm receipt of presigned manifest. I'll validate hashes and get back with follow-ups. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
